claims.sourceText: Guide to Federal Records in the National Archives of the United States, Record Group 330, section 330.11
claims.text: The Research and Development Board was 'Established as the Research and Development Board by the National Security Act of 1947 (61 Stat. 495), July 26, 1947. Abolished by Reorganization Plan No. 6 of 1953, effective June 30, 1953, and superseded by Office of the Assistant Secretary of Defense (Research and Development).'

claims.sourceText: Guide to Federal Records in the National Archives, Record Group 330, section 330.11
claims.text: Its successor office was 'Redesignated Office of the Director of Defense Research and Engineering by DOD Reorganization Act of 1958 (72 Stat. 514), August 6, 1958.'

claims.sourceText: Guide to Federal Records in the National Archives, Record Group 330, section 330.11.3
claims.text: NARA's finding aid lists surviving textual records of the Board at section 330.11.3, including 'Minutes of meetings of the Executive Council, 1946-50' and 'Records of the Committee on Technical Information, 1946-53'.

claims.sourceText: Sarbacher to Steinman, 29 November 1983, facsimile, read against the NARA finding aid for Record Group 330
claims.text: The letter contains an internal date error in its most-quoted paragraph: Sarbacher writes of 'My association with the Research and Development Board under Doctor Compton during the Eisenhower administration.' The RDB was established by the National Security Act of 1947 and abolished 30 June 1953; Karl T. Compton chaired it in the late 1940s, under Truman.
